description:
**Phase G — Tree session integration. Deps: G5b, G2.**

Wire post-selection flow. The 'Summarize?' prompt itself is in `tmp/pi-mono/.../interactive-mode.ts:4129-4141` (NOT in tree-selector.ts):
\`showExtensionSelector(\"Summarize?\", [\"Summarize\", \"Summarize with custom prompt\", \"No summary\"])\`

Map result to G2's three-valued `user_wants_summary` (`:no | :yes | {:yes, custom_instructions}`). 'Summarize with custom prompt' opens an editor for the custom instructions.

Tests: end-to-end UI flow exercising each branch.
title: G5c. Tree-selector: three-way 'Summarize?' prompt integration
